grid: N=16384 perT=20pi,6N steps to6T, fixed originalnondimensionalalpha3/10 model. Nootherstep or RK4rerun.
root_solver: Strictmonotone bracket between0 andRHS/Aroot, safeguardedNewton/bisection, atmost50iterations; acceptactualscalarresidual<=1e-13*max(1,absRHS). Keepactualnonzero root/midpointresiduals. Failure/overflow stop andretaincontext, noadjustment.
residuals: Evaluate Du/h-(vnext+v)/2; Dv/h+Cvm+Kum+e1Fm-fmid; DF/(kappa*h)-vm1+g(Fm) fromactualendpointaverages, not declared zero.
Lg: Float evaluation (10/3)*c^(-10/3)*max(absFn,absFnext)^(7/3), nominalsegmentderivative bound formula, not certified directed rounding.
budget: Exact proposalformula h*(1.001 L1ru+L1rv+3absrF)+h/4*(1.001 L1Dv+L1(CDv+KDu+e1DF)+2h a_n+3(absDv1+Lg absDF));a_n=1 fori<N else0; math.fsum prefix/total.
candidate_floats: early=maxnodes|uh1|+I_total;tail=sqrt(2E_end)+I_total;Tlower=absuh2(T)-I_prefix; compareTlower>maxearlytail. Noassertoutcome; allquantities floatingprototype, not intervalupperbounds or fulltailcertificate.
cache: Single local-cache/float_midpoint_endpoints_and_diagnostics.npz, onlyoneendpointtrajectory pluspersegment actualresidual/Lg/budgetmetadata; local only notstage/upload/log. Smallpublicblockaggregates andrepresentativeactualresidualrows, no fullarrayCSV. Futureintervalreview canrecompute fromendpoints.
comparison: Only originalR013 fineA scalarpeaks/E(T)/endcompleteenergy andbudgetdifferences; do notrerunRK4 or labelenergybalance asstateerror.
